tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/queue-lanes.test.ts: a summary-lane job queued while an index job runs does not start until the index lane is idle; a summary already running is not interrupted and an index job enqueued during it starts at once (the overlap case, replacing the pre-queued overlap assertion); the readers test is revised to the code-first order (a queued summary waits behind index work, laneStatus shows it queued); waitForIndexIdle resolves at once when the index lane is idle and on stop(), and a summary lane waiting for code work ends on stop()

cases.title: an index job enqueued while a summary job is running completes before that summary job finishes
each lane runs its jobs one at a time in order, every kind goes to its lane, and summaries queued with code work start only after it
depth, isProcessing and depthForRepo span both lanes, codeIndexWorkFor reads the index lane only, and laneStatus reports each lane
waitForIndexIdle resolves at once when the index lane is idle, after its code work otherwise, and on stop(); a summary lane waiting for code work ends on stop()
a summary never starts after a code job was queued: with the index lane idle at start it starts at once, and a code job queued just after runs beside that one summary only

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/doc-summary-sweep.test.ts: runDocSummarySweep awaits waitForCodeIdle before each single-document job and each document, an edit queued while it is paused runs before the next document, and it ends with stopped when shouldStop is true after the wait

cases.title: the sweep waits for code work before each single-document job and each document, runs an edit queued during the wait before the next document, and ends with stopped when shutdown comes during the wait
code work arriving while a document is read pauses the sweep again: an edit queued in that pause runs first, and shutdown in it ends the sweep without summarising
shutdown that comes while a document is read ends the sweep without summarising it

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/summary-sweep-progress.test.ts: the indexer's sweep pauses while the queue's index lane has work and continues when it is idle

cases.title: the indexer's sweep pauses while the queue's index lane has work and continues when it is idle
a summary never starts while code work is queued, even when the sweep wakes from its wait just before a code job arrives
an edited document queued while the indexer's sweep is paused for code work runs before the sweep's next document
a single-document summary waits while code work runs, runs once it is done, and is not started on shutdown
